verdict.rationale: Obsidian's internal-links docs confirm note linking with Wikilinks, which are on by default since the docs explain how to disable them. They also confirm links update automatically when a file is renamed. The evidence does not document a backlinks pane or unlinked-mention detection shown in context; the only backlink mention is a third-party plugin template, which earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented backlinks panel, unlinked mentions detection, in-context display of mentions, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can link notes with [[wiki-style]] links and see every backlink and unlinked mention of a note in context

citations.quote: If interoperability is important to you, you can disable Wikilinks and use Markdown links instead.
By linking notes, you can create a network of knowledge.
Obsidian can automatically update internal links in your vault when you rename a file.
